Summarize the following announcement in no more than 50 words.

The Riverside Public Library will extend its weekday hours starting March 3, staying open until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday. The change follows a community survey in which 68 percent of respondents asked for evening access. The extended hours are funded by a two-year state grant, and the library will hire four part-time staff to cover the new shifts.

Summarize this study in exactly 3 bullet points.

Researchers at a university sleep lab tracked 120 adults for six weeks. Participants who slept at least seven hours a night scored 20 percent higher on memory recall tests than those who slept under six hours. The team noted the study was observational, so it cannot prove that sleep directly causes better memory, and called for a controlled trial.

Summarize this earnings report in one paragraph of at most 60 words.

Northwind Outfitters reported third-quarter revenue of $412 million, up 9 percent from a year earlier, driven mainly by online sales. Net profit fell 4 percent to $31 million because of higher shipping costs. The company kept its full-year revenue forecast unchanged and said it plans to open 12 new stores next year.

Summarize this news item in exactly 3 bullet points.

The city council approved a $2.3 million plan to restore Mill Creek Park. The project will replace invasive plants with native species, rebuild the eroded creek banks, and add a 1.5-mile accessible trail. Work begins in April and is expected to take 18 months, during which the park's north section will be closed.

Summarize these release notes for end users in exactly 3 bullet points.

Version 4.2 of the Tidepool editor adds a built-in terminal panel and support for split views. It fixes a bug that caused the editor to freeze when opening files larger than 50 MB. Support for the legacy plugin API has been removed; plugin authors must migrate to the new API before upgrading.

Summarize this survey in at most 60 words.

A survey of 2,000 office workers found that 61 percent prefer a hybrid schedule, 24 percent want to work fully remotely, and 15 percent prefer being in the office full time. Respondents most often cited commute time as the reason for wanting remote days, while those preferring the office cited easier collaboration. Managers in the survey were more likely than staff to favor full-time office work.

Summarize this notice in no more than 50 words.

The Harbor Street Bridge will close to all vehicle traffic from June 10 to August 22 for deck repairs. Pedestrians and cyclists can still cross using a protected lane on the east side. Drivers are advised to use the Fifth Avenue Bridge as a detour, and two extra bus routes will run during the closure.
